<div class="text-muted mt-4">14 May 2026</div>
<h5><strong>New Paper Published in <em>Environmental Research Letters</em></strong></h5>
<p>Using CMIP6 projections, this study shows that intensifying climate extremes — droughts, heatwaves, and anomalous wet periods — will amplify the year-to-year swings in plant productivity across Central Asia's arid and semi-arid ecosystems, making carbon uptake increasingly unpredictable under future warming.</p>
<p><small class="text-muted">Chu, D., Zhang, L., Wu, H., He, H., &amp; Ren, X. (2026). <em>Environmental Research Letters.</em> DOI: 10.1088/1748-9326/ae6dd4</small></p>
<a href="https://doi.org/10.1088/1748-9326/ae6dd4" class="btn btn-primary" target="_blank">Read Paper</a>
